prompt: Elements `[100, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 20]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[100, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30, 20]` to `[20, 40, 30, 50, 70, 100, 60]`.
